record.paper_title: Heavy flavors and quarkonia: highlights, open questions, and perspectives
record.context_brief: Λc+/D0 ratio at very low multiplicity
record.original_question: Across pp, p–Pb, Pb–Pb, and Au–Au collisions, the pT-integrated Λc+/D0 production ratio is approximately 0.5 and much larger than the roughly 0.11 ratio measured in e+e− and ep collisions, with no observed multiplicity dependence within uncertainties. At very low charged-particle multiplicity, where current measurements do not yet exist, does the Λc+/D0 ratio return to the e+e− and ep value, or does the enhanced charm-baryon production persist even when hadronic activity is very small?

evidence.quote: The right panel of Fig. 4 shows the evolution of the pT-integrated Λ+c/D0 ratio as a function of the charged-particle multiplicity at midrapidity measured by ALICE in pp, p–Pb, and Pb–Pb collisions [14] and by STAR in Au–Au collisions [20].
The ratio is approximately around 0.5, thus much higher than the ≈ 0.11 value measured in e+e− and ep collisions, and, within uncertainties, it does not show a dependence on multiplicity.
The region of very low multiplicities is not covered by measurements, thus leaving open the question if the e+e− values might be recovered when the hadronic activity in the event is very small.

artifact.self_contained_problem: In high-energy hadronic collisions, charm quarks hadronize into a variety of charm hadrons, including the meson D^0 and the baryon Λ_c^+. Define the pT-integrated production ratio Λ_c^+/D^0 as the ratio of the production cross sections (or yields) of Λ_c^+ baryons to D^0 mesons, integrated over transverse momentum at midrapidity. Existing measurements in proton–proton (pp), proton–lead (p–Pb), lead–lead (Pb–Pb), and gold–gold (Au–Au) collisions give a pT-integrated Λ_c^+/D^0 ratio of approximately 0.5, essentially independent of the charged-particle multiplicity at midrapidity within current uncertainties, while measurements in e^+e^- and ep collisions give a ratio of approximately 0.11. Current hadronic measurements do not extend to the regime of very low charged-particle multiplicity. Determine whether, in the limit of very low charged-particle multiplicity at midrapidity in pp collisions, the pT-integrated Λ_c^+/D^0 ratio converges back to the value ≈ 0.11 observed in e^+e^- and ep collisions, or whether the enhanced charm-baryon production (ratio ≈ 0.5) persists even when the hadronic activity is very small.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent ALICE activity (including preliminary results presented at conferences in 2025 and an arXiv preprint on a precise Λ_c^+/D^0 measurement at RHIC from late 2025) shows ongoing efforts to extend Λ_c^+/D^0 measurements toward the lowest multiplicities ever probed at the LHC, but published results indicate that current precision does not yet allow a definitive conclusion on whether the ratio returns to the e^+e^-/ep value at very low multiplicity. The question therefore appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Towards a precise measurement of the Λ_c^+/D^0 ratio at RHIC
status_evidence.snippet: Recent efforts to precisely measure the Λ_c^+/D^0 ratio across collision systems and multiplicities.
status_evidence.claim: Active, ongoing measurement program suggests the very-low-multiplicity question is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: Multiplicity dependence of Ξ_c production in pp collisions at √s=13 TeV
status_evidence.snippet: ALICE measurements of charm-baryon production as a function of multiplicity in pp collisions.
status_evidence.claim: Charm-baryon-to-meson ratios as a function of multiplicity are being measured, but conclusions at very low multiplicity remain limited by precision.

status_evidence.title: ALICE Briefing for SQM 2026
status_evidence.snippet: Highest granularity in multiplicity slicing allowed extending to the lowest multiplicities ever probed at the LHC.
status_evidence.claim: Measurements are being extended to lower multiplicities but a definitive answer on convergence to the e^+e^- value has not been announced.
